title: console: Packaged Automation's clone result offers no way to switch the source flow off, though the clone runs beside it and the sharing-rule clone dialog offers one
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2207, the maintainer's browser round on ObjectStack 18.0.0 (「hotcrm 升级到 objectstack 18.0 然后重新安排一轮浏览器测试」). Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-01** of track 2 (the Setup pass as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01BkRPwuAufrFwoEEfuigDm9`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `16c28664` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (framework `06cab4849`, console objectui `616df6598b42`), in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-v18-setup-pass` at `4d7cc467d` ([`REPORT.md`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md)), which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. The behaviour of the clone itself is objectstack's declared design and is not what this card asks to change.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Setup → Apps → Packaged Automation (`/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/component/automation/packaged`).
- **Steps:**
  1. On `contact_welcome` (record-change, contact created), Clone → name `qa_contact_welcome_copy` → `200 POST /api/v1/automation/contact_welcome/clone`.
  2. Create one contact.
- **Actual:**
  - One contact produced **2** `contact_welcome` notifications: the original and the clone both ran.
  - The page shows the server's notice and no action. The notice's only instruction is a REST call: "send its complete definition with `status: 'obsolete'` to `PUT /api/v1/automation/<name>`. The activation toggle (`POST /api/v1/automation/<name>/toggle`) switches packaged flows only and refuses the clone."
- **Expected (the product's own sibling):** Declared Sharing Rules' Clone result says "The declared rule … still grants access until you switch it off" and offers a **Switch "…" off** button ([`16-access-declared-sharing-rules-cloned.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/16-access-declared-sharing-rules-cloned.png)).
- **Evidence:** [`03-F01-packaged-automation-clone-runs-beside-original.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/03-F01-packaged-automation-clone-runs-beside-original.png).
- **Reach:** every admin who customises a packaged record-change or schedule flow by cloning it. Until they find another door, each record runs the business logic twice.

## Seat review (source at the tested pins)

- **By design, not this card:**
  - The clone is created `draft`, which stays bound to its trigger (`objectstack` `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts:97-112`, `FLOW_CLONE_STATUS = 'draft'`).
  - The notice says so (`flow-clone.ts:177-185`).
  - ADR-0126 (`docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md:338`): "Clone and disable are **independent primitives**".
  - The page lists packaged flows only (`objectui` `packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx:373`), and the toggle is the packaged-flow ledger (objectstack#20726).
- **The defect:** after a successful clone, `PackagedAutomationPage.tsx:429` renders `cloneResult.notice` as text and nothing else. The sibling `SharingRuleCloneDialog.tsx:176` offers `Switch "{source}" off` at the same moment.
- **Other doors exist but are not offered:**
  - The original's own switch is on the same table.
  - By source only (not verified in a browser), Studio's package-less scope `/studio/~org/automations` (objectui#11553, in the pin) lists the clone, with an enable switch.
  - The Setup page links to neither.
- **Narrowest statement:** the clone result on Packaged Automation offers no clickable next step (switch the source off, or open the clone), so the admin is left with two flows on one trigger and a REST recipe.

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue title (every state, #1–#24932) and every objectstack-ai/objectui issue title (#7–#13268), listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint (refreshed with `since=2026-10-19`) and matched case-insensitively. The search API is refused for this session.
- Related, closed: objectstack#20726 (the toggle refuses a customer flow; resolved by declaring the clone's own status as its off-switch, which is the notice quoted above); objectui#11553 and objectstack#21332 (the clone reached no Studio surface; fixed by the `~org` scope); objectui#6301 (the page's charter).
- Different: objectui#13159 (the "On" chip on unbound schedule flows).
- **New.**
